description: Slider field. A number chosen on a slider between a min and max, stepped by an interval. Rich per-type config: DefaultValue, MinValue, MaxValue, IntervalSize (all wire strings). Captured live headless via copilot 2026-08-12 (field sweep #47); ids de-identified.
notes: DefaultValue / MinValue / MaxValue / IntervalSize are all wire STRINGS holding numbers (captured "0"/"0"/"100"/"1"), not JSON numbers.
The min/max/interval ARE the built-in range validation — a Slider constrains its own value natively, no separate validation rule needed for bounds.
Computed: Slider is number-family; a source is family-inferred to fire onSelect (unverified). Any field can be a computed target.
